scope: Exploratory explanations of the saved patient-isolated full-outer-training XGBoost component, not the 50:50 ensemble, original historical SHAP analysis, LightGBM S6 model, or causal effects
training: None; reuse all five saved full_xgb.ubj models, their full_package.joblib preprocessing, prepared matrices, original labels and patient roles from original_v5_independent_validation_v1
explanation: Exact native XGBoost pred_contribs with approx_contribs=false; all outer-test rows once; contribution scale is raw margin (log odds); exclude bias from feature summaries
split_checks: Reproduce original five-fold outer and inner patient roles; verify full outer train and test are disjoint; never explain a patient's own training fold
association: Two-sided scipy Spearman correlation between raw finite observed feature values and that feature's held-out margin contribution; true observed zero retained, missing/infinite raw values excluded rather than replaced by imputed zero
testability: At least three raw observations, at least two distinct raw values and at least two distinct contributions in that observed subset; otherwise report not testable and reason
multiplicity: One complete joint BH family comprising every testable pooled feature-cohort association across both cohorts, including demographic, region and any other nominal inputs; no feature selection by previous importance or P values; q<0.05 is exploratory only
fold_consistency: Repeat observed-only Spearman separately within each of five held-out folds; report positive, negative, zero and untestable counts and agreement with pooled sign; no fold P threshold selection and no fold FDR claims
importance: Mean absolute held-out contribution over all patients, and observed/missing subsets separately; all nominal features reported; zero-importance and non-testable features retained
cross_cohort: Describe sign agreement/opposition for features testable in both centres; additionally report both joint-BH q<0.05 and all-five-fold sign agreement as descriptive filters, not cross-centre interaction tests or proof of biological drift
missingness_sensitivity: Use already saved heldout_xgb_contributions for value_indicator_ensemble XGBoost component and native_xgb, verify identical patient roles and probabilities, compare ranks of mean absolute contributions for the same original 104 value channels; indicator channels reported separately; report all-feature and nonzero-union Spearman rank correlation plus nonzero top-10/top-20 overlap with deterministic feature-order tie breaking
limits: No random-seed retraining stability, repeated cross-validation or new external cohort is evaluated.

Fold-specific models share training patients; pooled nominal Spearman P values and BH values are exploratory and do not establish confirmatory FDR control, biological causality or an independent between-cohort effect.
Conditional explanations cannot repair full-record aggregation, ever-diagnosis labels, predictor timing, treatment confounding or source provenance.
SHAP directions can depend on feature dependence, missingness handling and model fitting; mean absolute contribution is predictive attribution, not clinical effect size.
Missingness variants change models and feature spaces; rank changes are descriptive robustness evidence, not a pure causal effect of missingness handling.
